text: A darkly romantic and eerie gothic scene: A beautiful young woman with long, flowing crimson red hair sits on a velvet-draped bed in an ancient, opulent bedroom. She wears a delicate, ruffled white Victorian-style nightgown with lace trim and puffed sleeves, her expression serene yet focused as she reads an open, aged spellbook resting on her lap. The book is thick, leather-bound, with gold-embossed runes and occult symbols — prominently featuring a pentagram within a circle on the right page. Her hands gently hold the pages open; one hand rests near a glowing candlestick beside her. Behind her looms a ghostly, translucent female specter — spectral and haunting — draped in tattered white veils that flow like smoke. The ghost has pale, ethereal skin, hollow eyes glowing with an eerie blue-white light, and long, skeletal fingers ending in sharp claws. Her form is semi-transparent, revealing faint outlines of ancient robes underneath. She hovers menacingly but not aggressively, as if observing or guarding the woman’s ritual. The room is dimly lit by candlelight: one candle flickers on a brass candelabra to her left, and another small lantern glows near the book. The background features heavy velvet curtains in deep burgundy and gold embroidery, ornate carved furniture, dusty tapestries, and cobwebbed corners — all contributing to a mysterious, gothic atmosphere. Soft shadows and chiaroscuro lighting emphasize texture, depth, and drama. The overall mood is supernatural, mystical, and slightly ominous — a blend of beauty and horror, reminiscent of Victorian gothic fiction or fantasy art. Hyper-detailed, cinematic composition, 8K resolution, rich color palette with deep reds, dark velvet tones, glowing whites, and golden highlights. Style: dramatic fantasy illustration with painterly textures, inspired by artists like Artgerm, Alan Lee, and concept art from games like ‘The Witcher’ or ‘Dark Souls’
